house.description: Hermantown; historic Mary Murphy home, museum, and park renovation and preservation funding provided; and money appropriated.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Legacy Finance
Authors added Hansen, R.; Lee, F.; Bahner, and Klevorn

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money to renovate and preserve the historic Mary Murphy home, museum, and park in the city of Hermantown.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; MARY MURPHY HOME, MUSEUM, AND PARK. +]

[+$250,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the governing board of the Minnesota Historical Society for a grant to the city of Hermantown to preserve and renovate the State Representative Mary Murphy home, museum, and park. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money to renovate and preserve the historic Mary Murphy home, museum, and park in the city of Hermantown.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; MARY MURPHY HOME, MUSEUM, AND PARK.

$250,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the governing board of the Minnesota Historical Society for a grant to the city of Hermantown to preserve and renovate the State Representative Mary Murphy home, museum, and park.
additions: APPROPRIATION; MARY MURPHY HOME, MUSEUM, AND PARK.
